race.comment: TRULY GALLANT (2) was beaten a nose by ALDEZOR at this track last start after being sent out an odds-on favourite, and his record at this track and distance gives him the right profile to atone third-up. He also has a 3kg claim to help offset the weight, so the winning case is clear. ALDEZOR (3) has won both runs this campaign at this venue, including that narrow defeat of TRULY GALLANT, and keeps the winning rider. Out to thye mile doesn't look an issue and he can keep his winning streak alive. NOBLE TOUCH (7) was only just over half a length from ALDEZOR and TRULY GALLANT last time and is proven at this distance, making her a genuine danger with the step back to a winning range. SKY RIVER (9) comes through a nose defeat at York in BM44+ company and has two wins around this trip, so she has the credentials to run well if reproducing that latest effort. GOLD LIGHTNING (5) comes through the ALDEZOR race which shapes as a key reference.
